description: Stunning air-conditioned apartment in an elegant Haussmannian building, just steps from the Louvre Museum. Set in one of Paris’s most prestigious areas, it is surrounded by refined cafés, boutiques, and restaurants. With its high ceilings, classic moldings, and sophisticated décor, it blends Parisian charm with modern luxury. Bright and fully equipped, it offers an exceptional setting for an unforgettable stay.The spaceThis 120 sqm apartment is located on the 2nd floor with elevator, fully air-conditioned, featuring high ceilings, and can accommodate up to: • 2 bedrooms with queen-size beds (160 cm) located on the main level • 1 third bedroom with a queen-size bed (160 cm), located on the upper level and accessible via an internal staircase • A living room with a sofa bed, coffee table, and armchairs • Smart TV, Wi-Fi • A dining area with a fully equipped kitchen (stovetop, oven, toaster, Nespresso machine, washer-dryer, dishwasher) • 2 bathrooms with showers, including one with a toilet • 1 separate toilet⚠️ Please note: the third bedroom is accessible via an internal staircase. It may not be suitable for guests with reduced mobility or young children without supervision.The cleaning fee includes fresh bed linens and towels for each guest, and cleaning is carried out by a professional housekeeper.Guest accessTravelers have access to the entire apartmentOther things to noteADDITIONAL Services (optional)• Baby bed: Price - 60€/stayThis booking is protected with coverage for lost baggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Swift Travel Cover with claim up to 750 Euros (T&C Applies). Full details available at booking.
